The new plan has to be added to the `PlanId` union in `src/types/billing.ts:9` (`"free" | "starter" | "growth" | "enterprise"`). I found 20 files that name the type in an import, annotation, type argument, or `Record` key. I got this from a repo-wide text search for `PlanId`, not from a type-checker run.

Three things I left out:
- `corpus-manifest.json` contains `PlanId` in signature strings. It is generated from `scripts/manifest-parts/`, so it should be regenerated rather than hand-edited.
- `scripts/manifest-parts/domain.ts` and `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts` also use `PlanId` only inside signature string literals, not in code. If you count those strings as naming the type, add them to the list.
- Files that only call `getPlanLimits`, `getLimit`, or `planAtLeast` never name the type, so they are out of scope.

Files that name `PlanId`:
- **Definition:** `src/types/billing.ts` (union declaration, `PLAN_IDS`, plan-typed fields)
- **Types and schemas:** `src/types/organization.ts`, `src/types/event.ts` (`billing.plan_changed` payload), `src/types/feature-flag.ts`, `src/schemas/billing.ts` (`_planParity` annotation)
- **Config and `Record` keys:** `src/config/plan-limits.ts` (`PLAN_LIMITS: Record<PlanId, …>`, `PLAN_ORDER`), `src/app/(marketing)/_components/pricing-grid.tsx` (`PLAN_BLURBS: Record<PlanId, string>`)
- **Server:** `src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts`, `src/server/services/billing-service.ts`, `src/server/db/seed.ts`, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`
- **Components and pages:** `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx`, `src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx`, `src/components/domain/billing/plan-comparison-table.tsx`, `src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx`
- **Tests:** `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`, `tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts`, `tests/components/command-groups.test.ts`, `tests/config/nav.test.ts`, `tests/jobs/digest-email-job.test.ts`
